scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p packages/renderer-react && tsc -p packages/sandbox && tsc -p hosts/wordpress/adapter && tsc -p hosts/wordpress/e2e && tsc -p hosts/emdash/adapter && tsc -p hosts/emdash/e2e
scripts.verify:examples: tsx packages/cli/src/main.ts verify --surface hosts/wordpress/plugin/surfaces/7.1.json --spec examples/specs examples/builds/review-queue.json examples/builds/quick-approve.json examples/builds/waiting-posts.json examples/builds/stale-drafts.json examples/builds/headline-check.json
scripts.verify:emdash: tsx packages/cli/src/main.ts verify --surface hosts/emdash/adapter/surfaces/1.0.json --spec examples/emdash/specs examples/emdash/builds/publish-queue.json examples/emdash/builds/go-live.json examples/emdash/builds/drafts-glance.json examples/emdash/builds/stale-drafts.json
scripts.test:author:emdash: pnpm build:emdash && tsx hosts/emdash/adapter/src/node/author-test.ts --format native && tsx hosts/emdash/adapter/src/node/author-test.ts --format sandboxed
